_doc: MOONSHOT v1 cue sheet. Times in seconds of the final 24 fps timeline. Total length 90.0 s. Key: D minor for tension, resolves to D major / Bb-F-C-D lift at the climax swell.

sections.name: cold_open
sections.notes: Black + countdown dialogue. Low drone (D1/D2, slow filter movement), heartbeat starting ~66 bpm at 0.3 s accelerating to ~110 bpm by 10.0 s, a sub swell, and a rising noise/tonal riser 6.0->10.35. Hard 'suck-back' (reverse swell) 9.9->10.35 then near-silence 10.35->10.6 so the drop hits.

sections.name: drop
sections.notes: 10.6 MASSIVE impact: sub boom (pitch-dropping sine 60->28 Hz, 2.5 s tail), distorted low brass-like chord (D2+A2+D3+F3, saw stack through soft clip + lowpass opening), long rumble bed (filtered brown noise) under the whole section. 12.9 whoosh-in (0.3 s). 13.2 second impact (title punch): shorter, brighter, with a metallic ring. 17.2->17.6 whoosh-out.

sections.name: act2_groove
sections.notes: Driving trailer ostinato at 120 bpm (beat = 0.5 s, beat 1 = 19.0): 16th-note pulsing synth bass in D minor (D-D-D-F / D-D-C-A pattern every bar), toms/low drums on beats 1 and 3 with a big hit every 2 bars, ticking hi-hat 8ths, a sustained string-like pad (detuned saws, lowpassed) moving i-VI-III-VII (Dm-Bb-F-C), 2 bars per chord. Risers into 26.0 and 34.0 (2 s each). Impacts on 26.0, 34.0 and 37.0. Energy builds; 38.0->40.0 short riser into a cut.

sections.name: lunar_transition
sections.notes: Groove stops dead at 40.0 (tail only). Wide eerie pad (high shimmer, slow tremolo), sparse sonar-like ping at 40.0 and 42.0, sub drone D1.

sections.name: descent_tension
sections.notes: Tension bed: low pulse in D (quarter notes at 120 bpm but very muted), clock tick (8ths) 44->66, heartbeat returns at 52.0 (~90 bpm) accelerating to ~140 bpm by 66.0. 47.0->55.0 is the 1202 alarm sequence: music ducks and stutters (gate/chop the pad in 1/16 pulses) between 47.0 and 49.0, returns. 55.0->63.0 Shepard-tone style rising riser (endless rise) that builds to max at 63.0. Then 63.0->68.6 hold one sustained high cluster with nothing else (the 'Eagle has landed' dialogue sits here).

sections.name: flash_silence
sections.notes: 68.6 everything cuts to digital silence (sharp 5 ms fade) for 1.0 s. Only a very quiet room tone (-60 dBFS) may remain.

sections.name: swell_outro
sections.notes: 69.6 the emotional swell: warm wide major pad (D major, add9), slow attack 1.5 s, low strings-like saw ensemble, soft timpani-like roll into 76.0. Progression Bb-F-C-D (2.5 s each, from 69.6), repeat. 83.4 final title impact (warm, big, sub + reverb tail), then pad holds and fades to silence by 89.8.

sfx.notes: soft telemetry blips every 0.25 s while a chart draws, very low level
LM master alarm style: two-tone ~750/1250 Hz beeping, harsh, short
very short bright transient then hard silence
starts at 68.4 under silence? NO: begins 69.6 quietly
